bootstate_audit.exact_vendor_semantics: GPT COMMITTED2 branch calls getBootReason, which returns raw hexadecimal strtoul unchanged; compares full value with integer1 and selects PART2 when different. It does not mask to the low nibble.
bootstate_audit.conservative_candidate_semantics: Require <=16bit hexadecimal, known current reason0,2,4 and phase0x00..0x60; reject ACTIVATE nibble1 even with phase/history bits. Upper byte is preserved history. This is intentionally stricter than vendor, and may refuse an unexpected first-trial encoding.
bootstate_audit.observed_raw: 134 (no newline), from separately recorded read-only current kernel9 capture; not presumed exact future kernel10 startup value.
bootstate_audit.seq_bound: Primary SDK sets newly written image seq=(other+1)%1000; accept canonical decimal0..999; never compile current5,4.
bootstate_audit.token: /etc/leon/trial-slot-proof root0600, exact5-line schema. Requires final postflash metadata fullhash + pinned full stock p5/p6 hashes; no token generated by these scripts.

production_guardian.scope: Source includes two-phase preflight/arm/exec/confirmed-abort, native worker health, authenticated ACK and immutable ownership query, metadata recheck, sole hardware adapter. Compile-time deployment gate is fixedfalse.
